text:
Lina P.: quick heads-up — starting a focused bakeoff: SmoothQuant + activation-aware (AWQ) vs GPTQ and FP8 on long ctx (70k). goal: repro latency/cost profiles + quality deltas on long prompts.
Arpit S.: sgtm. what metrics are we capturing?
Lina P.: perplexity, exact-match on our long-doc QA set, token-level F1, and distributional drift (KL vs fp16 baseline). also KV cache miss rates and memory high-water marks.
Morgan T.: can we add a simple prompt-adversary set (repeats / long inits) to trigger cache thrash? saw weird perf before.
Lina P.: yes — creating a small suite called `longctx-thrash-70k` (10 adversarial prompts).
Ben K.: what's the hardware/runner config? I want to ensure the runtime picks same kernels.
Lina P.: running on dedicated p4d-like nodes (8xA100-40GB), runtime=redwood-runtime-2.1. config snippet:```model: redwood/long-7b
quant: {method: smoothquant+awq, act_bits:8, weight_bits:8}
batch_size: 1
max_seq: 70000
kv_policy: dynamic_eviction
metrics: [ppl,exact_match,f1,kv_evictions]
```
Arpit S.: will also run gptq baseline with these params:```quant: {method: gptq, bits:8, per_channel: true}
```
Lina P.: timeline: 2 runs today (SQ+AWQ, GPTQ), FP8 mixed later if SQ shows stable memory.
EvalBot: automated eval started for thread 1865004321 — expected finish in ~45m.
Morgan T.: tiny concern: AWQ calibration step previously inflated activation ranges for repeated prefixes — might need per-shard calibration. add note to compare calibration logs.
Lina P.: good call. logging both `act_scale_stats.json` and per-layer histograms.
Ben K.: also capture kernel selection logs (which cuBLAS/flash/kernels picked) — differences may explain perf regressions.
Arpit S.: if we see >1.5% QA exact-match drop vs fp16 we should halt rollout candidate. documented?
Lina P.: yes policy: <1% acceptable, 1-2% review, >2% reject for production.
Morgan T.: running smoke on one shard now, posting early numbers in a sec.
Morgan T.: smoke results (one shard): SQ+AWQ -> ppl +0.9 vs fp16, exact-match -0.6%, kv_evictions spike +12% during long tail.
Lina P.: thanks — kv_evictions +12% is worrying, could be policy mismatch. what was kv_policy?
Morgan T.: dynamic_eviction w/ 64k soft cap.
Ben K.: try bumping soft cap to 96k for longctx tests (we have memory headroom on these nodes).
Arpit S.: also try running with `kv_prefetch: true` (cheap) to avoid eviction churn.
Lina P.: scheduling second pass: SQ+AWQ with soft_cap=96k and kv_prefetch=true; GPTQ baseline unchanged.
EvalBot: run update: additional config applied to job 1865004321-2.
Morgan T.: quick note: AWQ quantizer produced a few outlier layers with high act_scale — I'm dumping layer ids.
Lina P.: please tag them in the results PR and include a diffs table. I want to see layerwise exact-match impact.
Ben K.: if AWQ outliers correlate with high-attention projection layers, we may try act-aware clipping there or hybrid quant (int8 weights + fp16 activations for those layers).
Lina P.: agreed. plan: if exact-match drop >1% after soft_cap bump, test hybrid per-layer fp16 in problematic layers.
Morgan T.: mid-run numbers: SQ+AWQ (soft_cap=96k) -> ppl +0.6, exact-match -0.2, kv_evictions -4% (better).
Lina P.: nice, seems to help. any perf impact?
Morgan T.: latency per token increased ~3% due to larger kv footprint, throughput stable.
Arpit S.: trade-off looks acceptable for correctness. record cost delta too.
Lina P.: will push a short bakeoff summary and artifacts: logs, `act_scale_stats.json`, kernel logs, eval tables. PR later today.
Ben K.: one more ask — include model seed runs (3 seeds) to check variance.
Lina P.: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
EvalBot: automated eval complete. summary URL: https://evals.internal/redwood/1865004321/results
Lina P.: linking results in #eng-ml and creating follow-up card for per-layer hybrid tests.
